gaps.explanation: Every governmental fund column is covered by a schedule in detail; the schedules are Budget and Actual (CASH BASIS), the statement (p4) is modified accrual. Printed totals: General Fund cash 84,720,509 (p8) vs statement 84,702,094 (+18,415); Special Roads cash 22,482,335 (p10) vs 20,662,496 (+1,819,839); COVID American Recovery Plan cash 18,180,314 (p11) vs 14,002,672 (+4,177,642); All Non-Major Special Revenue Funds cash 12,093,207 (p12) vs Non-major Funds 13,653,900 (-1,560,693). Schedule 137,476,365 - statement 133,021,162 = 4,455,203 = 18,415 + 1,819,839 + 4,177,642 - 1,560,693. No line missing or duplicated; no fix.

Cash-basis budget schedules vs the GAAP statement (p4). Printed totals: General Fund expenditures paid 74,555,888 (p9) vs statement 102,648,630 (-28,092,742; the GAAP column includes bond-financed construction paid from the escrow account, which the cash schedule leaves out: p9 reconciliation prints 'Disbursements of cash from escrow account for construction (21,460,132)' and 'for issuance costs (149,500)', plus noncash lease financing 557,054 and accruals); Special Roads 32,163,694 (p10) vs 64,327,409 (-32,163,715; Series 2021/2022 highway allocation bond-financed capital outlay, p10 reconciliation); COVID ARPA 13,786,923 (p11) vs 13,802,237 (-15,314); Non-Major 19,871,373 (p12) vs 19,274,950 (+596,423). Statement 200,053,226 - schedule 140,377,878 = 59,675,348 = 28,092,742 + 32,163,715 + 15,314 - 596,423. No fund column is missing (all four statement columns have schedules); no fix.

Cash budget schedules: Operating transfer in General 22,000 (p9) + Special Roads 3,150,000 (p10) + Non-Major 5,689,744 (p12) = 8,861,744. Statement p4: General 400,641 + Special Roads 3,692,805 + Non-major 5,648,244 = 9,741,690. Differences 378,641 + 542,805 - 41,500 = 879,946 (GAAP reclassification of interfund amounts, e.g. escrow/bond transfers, not in the cash budget). No fix.

Cash budget schedules: Operating transfer out General (9,417,000) (p9) + COVID ARPA (200,435) (p11) + Non-Major (794,744) (p12) = 10,412,179. Statement p4: General (9,918,305) + ARPA (200,435) + Non-major (1,173,385) = 11,292,125. Differences 501,305 + 0 + 378,641 = 879,946, the same amount as transfers in (GAAP vs cash budget treatment of interfund transfers). No fix.
